name: call-recordings
description: Read Apple call recordings out of the macOS Notes store from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Read Apple call recordings from the Notes store
interface.longDescription: Enumerate Apple's built-in phone and FaceTime call recordings by reading the Notes Core Data store directly, with real call start, end, and duration; resolve a call to its audio file; and extract Apple's call transcript when the note carries one.
